headline: Tehran 'tapping it along' waiting for the election
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Trump, asked when the Iran war ends: 'It's a question of when do I want to end it... They've wanted to make a deal, but they like tapping it along.
sources: Donald Trump, remarks to reporters (Oct 27) + Lubbock, Texas rally (Oct 28 local)
fault_line: Is the war's end Trump's personal decision and timing -- or does Tehran's 'waiting for the election' mean the timing is negotiated, not dictated?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Trump, asked when the Iran war ends: 'It's a question of when do I want to end it... They've wanted to make a deal, but they like tapping it along. Maybe they're waiting for the election or something -- but that's not gonna help them.' At Lubbock he added: 'America did not start the war with Iran. Iran has been waging this war against America since 1979' and 'Whenever I want it to end.' In the same remarks he claimed the US has 'decimated their military' and 'decimated their finances', that Iran 'has no money', and cited inflation of '301% a couple of days ago' -- all HIS assertions, not verified statistics. The 'anything's possible' line on post-election strikes is NOT new here (already in totw-20261028-1900-01 via Haaretz). This item is the TIMING framing, and it lands days before the Nov 3 midterms.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source single family: Trump's own on-camera words (CBS News reel, Oct 27, retrieved via social.search) + verbatim quotes in Times of India liveblog (T3). CBS News and Independent Persian carry the same primary statement and are NOT counted as extra families; CBS is undeclared in the registry. The 301% inflation figure and 'decimated' claims are Trump's assertions, unverified.
sections.what_disputed: No US official confirmation of a post-election attack plan exists (White House declined comment, totw-20261028-1900-01); Tehran's channel is the Qatar draft it has already rejected (totw-20261028-1800-03). Trump's 301% inflation figure has no independent verification in retrieved material.
sections.why_matters: Trump's own clock: the war ends 'whenever I want' -- days before the midterms. Title number must be attributed (his 301% claim) or the midterm countdown; pair with the HELD WSJ story as context, never present the WSJ plan as confirmed.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- Trump on-record: the Iran war ends 'when do I want to end it'; Tehran 'tapping it along' waiting for the election
